details.description: Code-specific details, e.g. [{ path, message }] for validation_failed.

message.description: Human-readable English message; clients translate by code.

requestId.description: The X-Request-Id of the request, for support and log correlation.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase Auth access token (staff), or an MCP key on /mcp routes.

posDeviceAuth.description: Paired POS device credential (POST /v1/pos/pair). Accepted only on the POS device routes (/v1/pos/...).

info.description: Generated from the Nest router and the @resuto/contracts schemas (docs/API_STYLE.md). Errors use the Error envelope; lists answer { items, nextCursor } and take limit (1-200) and an opaque cursor.
